subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require a current-main Windows/WSL two-run `pnpm build` repro before choosing between a tsdown dependency fix, wrapper fix, or build-system rollback?
rationale: The report is plausible and affects a supported setup/build surface, but the requested remedy replaces the build tool and cannot be selected safely without live repro and maintainer build-system direction.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Run or request current-main Windows and WSL first-run plus second-run build logs before choosing the fix direction.

options.title: Approve narrow tsdown investigation
options.body: Treat the issue as urgent build-tool work and first try a dependency update, pin, or wrapper repair with Windows/WSL proof.

options.title: Choose rollback direction
options.body: Explicitly decide that tsdown is unacceptable for this surface and scope a broader rollback or replacement plan.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request current-main Windows and WSL first-run plus second-run build logs before choosing the fix direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter was directly asked in the discussion and has the strongest sampled history across the affected build wrapper files.
